method: controlled admission beds with KNOWN ground truth, real oracle, real controls (noisy-TV, shuffled-target, wrong-time, rate-matched-random), 3 independent generator families, 2 implementations; a generic learned-allocation mechanism proxies each lane. Preregistration sealed before results; SESOI 0.05 fixed.

G1-P1R.repair: pruned_mechanism (fails D + F): allocation signal does not beat simple heuristics by SESOI and is architecture-dependent. Exact repair: redesign the estimator to capture the oracle-visible signal above heuristics AND make it architecture-robust before any re-admission; do not weaken the SESOI.

G1-U1.repair: insufficient_independent_units (fails E + F): strong on average but the effect does not hold across every independent generator family and is architecture-dependent. Exact repair: obtain more/stronger independent units OR a mechanism whose benefit holds group-disjoint and across implementations.

G1-N1.repair: architecture_dependent (fails F): strongest, group-disjoint signal, but the benefit exists only under one implementation (linear actively hurts). Exact repair: an architecture-robust estimator, or accept the effect as implementation-specific (which does not clear clause F).

dominant_finding: all three lanes FAIL clause F (architecture independence): the learned-allocation benefit exists only under kNN; the linear implementation gives negative incremental value. Even the strongest lane (N1) does not robustly clear the bar.
beds_valid: yes: oracle headroom 0.39-0.49 >> SESOI 0.05, so these are genuine mechanism failures, not invalid or underpowered beds.
canaries_run: NONE (no lane was admitted; the admission gate pruned all three before heavy compute, as designed)

compute_accounting.compute_avoided_by_pruning: the full canary + confirmation-cluster compute for three lanes

claim_ceiling: controlled-bed mechanism plausibility screen only; NOT scientific confirmation and NOT a claim that the real-world mechanisms are worthless. It is a cheap pre-canary gate; failing it is a valid terminal result that defers heavy compute.
phase5_launch_set: EMPTY. No lane is admitted, so no Phase 5 independent-confirmation cluster proceeds with G1-P1R, G1-U1, or G1-N1 as currently mechanized. Each carries a named repair. The overarching prerequisite is an architecture-robust allocation mechanism (all three fail clause F).
recommendation: Do not spend canary or cluster compute on these three lanes as-is. Redesign the mechanism to be architecture-robust and to beat heuristics group-disjoint, then re-run the SAME sealed admission battery. Do not weaken any gate. The next scientific compute must answer whether a repaired mechanism produces independently reproducible decision value, not merely re-run mechanics.
